Full API spec:
include/Random.h: interface IRandom and LcgRandom.
- struct IRandom { virtual ~IRandom() noexcept = default; virtual double nextUnit() = 0; }.
- class LcgRandom : public IRandom { explicit LcgRandom(std::uint64_t seed); std::uint64_t nextUint64(); double nextUnit() override; }.
Semantics: LcgRandom implements a 64-bit LCG with constants a=6364136223846793005, c=1; state is updated per call. nextUint64() returns the new state; nextUnit() returns (nextUint64() / (std::numeric_limits<uint64_t>::max()+1.0)) in [0,1).

include/GameConfig.h: struct GameConfig {
 double worldWidth, worldHeight; double gravity; double flapImpulse; double maxFallSpeed; double pipeSpeed; double pipeWidth; double pipeGapHeight; double pipeSpawnInterval; double birdX; double birdWidth; double birdHeight;
 static GameConfig Default(); void validate() const; }.
Semantics: Default() returns sane gameplay values. validate() throws std::invalid_argument on invalid: non-positive sizes/speeds; pipeGapHeight < worldHeight must hold; 0 <= birdX <= worldWidth-birdWidth; pipeWidth > 0; pipeSpawnInterval > 0; etc.

include/Bird.h: class Bird { public: Bird(double y0, double v0); void flap(const GameConfig& cfg); void update(double dt, const GameConfig& cfg); double y() const noexcept; double velocity() const noexcept; double top(const GameConfig& cfg) const noexcept; double bottom(const GameConfig& cfg) const noexcept; void reset(double y0) noexcept; }.
Semantics: Coordinates: y increases upward; top() = y()+birdHeight/2; bottom() = y()-birdHeight/2. flap() adds positive cfg.flapImpulse to velocity. update() applies gravity (v -= cfg.gravity*dt), clamps v >= -cfg.maxFallSpeed, integrates y += v*dt, clamps bird within [0, worldHeight] using std::clamp; touching top or bottom clamps position and may be considered a boundary contact by GameState.

include/Pipe.h: class Pipe { public: double x; double gapY; bool scored; Pipe(double x0, double gapY0); void update(double dt, const GameConfig& cfg); bool isOffscreen(const GameConfig& cfg) const; bool hasPassedBird(double birdX, const GameConfig& cfg) const; bool collidesWithBird(double birdX, double birdTop, double birdBottom, const GameConfig& cfg) const; }.
Semantics: Pipes move left at cfg.pipeSpeed: x -= cfg.pipeSpeed * dt. isOffscreen() true when x + pipeWidth < 0. hasPassedBird() true when x + pipeWidth < birdX. collidesWithBird() performs axis-aligned check: if bird overlaps pipe x-range [x, x+pipeWidth], then collision occurs unless bird is within vertical gap [gapY - pipeGapHeight/2, gapY + pipeGapHeight/2].

include/GameState.h: class GameState { public: explicit GameState(GameConfig cfg); void reset(); void flap(); void update(double dt, IRandom& rng); int score() const noexcept; bool gameOver() const noexcept; const std::vector<Pipe>& pipes() const noexcept; double birdY() const noexcept; double birdTop() const noexcept; double birdBottom() const noexcept; }.
Semantics: Owns Bird, Pipes, score, gameOver flag, and a spawn timer. Constructor stores cfg and initializes Bird centered vertically with zero velocity. reset() clears pipes/score/timer and recenters Bird. flap() delegates to Bird unless gameOver. update(): if gameOver, returns; else updates Bird, updates existing Pipes, spawns a new Pipe when timer exceeds cfg.pipeSpawnInterval: gapY derived from rng.nextUnit()*playable-range; clamps gap within play area; increments score exactly once per Pipe when it passes birdX; sets gameOver if collision with a Pipe or if Bird touches top/bottom; removes offscreen Pipes.

include/GameEngine.h: class GameEngine { public: GameEngine(GameConfig cfg, std::unique_ptr<IRandom> rng); void reset(); void flap(); void step(double dt); int score() const noexcept; bool isGameOver() const noexcept; double birdY() const noexcept; const std::vector<Pipe>& pipes() const noexcept; const GameConfig& config() const noexcept; }.
Semantics: Validates cfg in ctor (cfg.validate()). Holds RNG and GameState. step(dt) calls state_.update(dt, *rng_). flap() calls state_.flap() if not game over. reset() reinitializes GameState with same cfg and preserved RNG object/state.

Include and link rules: tests/test_main.cpp may include only headers under include/. Implementations reside in src/ and are compiled into a single core library. The runtime demo src/Main.cpp is environment-dependent and not linked into tests.
Shared Knowledge: Build via CMake: a single core library from all non-Main src/*.cpp files, linked to both the demo executable (src/Main.cpp) and the test executable (tests/test_main.cpp). Tests include only declared headers under include/ and never include src/*.cpp. Domain separation: pure deterministic core (Random, GameConfig, Bird, Pipe, GameState, GameEngine) vs environment boundary (Main). RNG is a seeded boundary (IRandom/LcgRandom) to guarantee reproducibility. All updates driven by deterministic dt.
Execution Protocol: Runtime entry: src/Main.cpp. Test target: tests/test_main.cpp. Build commands: mkdir -p build && cmake -S . -B build && cmake --build build. Run tests: ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure. The single test executable is registered with CTest. No manual interaction; headless and deterministic. Both runtime and test link against the same core library.
